jobs.description: Experience in contract management? Interested in an international environment and renewable energies? Then we have the perfect opportunity for you!The CPX (Customer Project Execution) department is responsible for the project management of all wind farm projects from the start of the contract to completion. The team will take responsibility for a wind farm after the contract has been signed and will remain responsible until the final tests have been completed. Working closely with the logistics, procurement, and finance departments, the project team ensures that the project stays on budget and on schedule, and that our safety and quality standards are met. In addition, the project team works closely with the sales and legal departments to ensure that each wind farm delivers the highest energy yield within the customer specification.ResponsibilitiesContract management safeguards Vestas' commercial interests during the construction phase of new wind farms. During this phase, we take on core tasks and support the project team with proactive and constant advice and recommendations on commercial and contractual issues related to the implementation of a project in terms of safety, quality, time and budget. For individual construction projects, Contract Management provides direct contract management support to the project team. The Contract Manager also ensures coordination with internal departments, including the legal and financial departments, sales and bid management. Your tasks will include:- Commercial and contractual support during the construction phase of new wind farms, including advising internal stakeholders on turbine supply contracts- Enforcing claims against clients and subcontractors as well as conducting negotiations with these parties- Ensuring compliance with internal processes in the creation, filing and documentation of correspondence and records- Responsibility for claims management, including assessment of potential damage scenarios, derivation of recommendations and writing formal letters- Contribution to risk management (ONS) through identification and assessment of contractual risks- Capture and analyze contract-related insights to help optimize and evolve contract structures- Working closely with internal stakeholders and management to ensure effective implementation of contractual obligationsQualifications- Academic degree in law or business law (Bachelor's, Master's or Diploma)- At least 4 years of professional experience in drafting, reviewing, negotiating and managing contracts- Sound knowledge of construction and energy contracts, preferably with experience in power plant projects (FIDIC or EPCI is an advantage) is an advantage- Language skills: Fluent in German and English, both oral and writtenCompetencies- Strong methodological, analytical and problem-solving skills as well as a structured, independent way of working- Ability to work in a team, intercultural understanding and very good communication skills at all levels – internally and externally- Willingness to travel of up to 20%Your benefits – because your commitment counts! - Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects - Development & Experience: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, Extra days off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, and the option for a sabbatical - Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) - Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and team spirit

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. The roleFor our global Mature Customer Marketing team in Berlin, we are looking for a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the lifecycle strategy for one these topics: merchandising, or partnerships & retail media. The Mature Customer Marketing team sits within the HelloFresh Group’s Global Customer Lifecycle organization. Our mission is simple: keep active customers active, and make sure they get the most out of their subscription — across our 6 brands, 18 countries and 30 markets.As a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you’ll be a critical link between strategy and execution, partnering closely with CRM, Product Marketing, Physical Product, Tech and local marketing teams to design, brief and scale programs that keep our customers engaged with their subscription.Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.What you’ll do- Own the lifecycle strategy deployment for your topic area and translate it into programs and campaigns that keep customers engaged with their subscription- Partner with Product Marketing, Physical Product and Tech to spot opportunities that improve the customer experience and support your topic’s goals- Brief campaigns end-to-end to CRM Operations and Creative teams, ensuring messaging, targeting and execution meet our lifecycle and brand standards- Work with local market teams across our 30 markets to adapt and roll out global strategy, balancing consistency with local relevance- Use data to test, measure and continuously optimize campaign performance- Track and report on the health of your topic area, flagging risks and opportunities to the wider Customer Engagement team- Support cross-topic initiatives across the team as neededWhat you’ll bring- Strong project management skills, with experience managing complex campaigns across a high number of cross-functional stakeholders, including CRM Operations, Creative, Tech, and local teams.- Strong creative briefing skills — experience translating marketing objectives, audience insights, and messaging needs into clear, inspiring briefs that give creative teams the direction and context needed to deliver strong work.- Commercial acumen — experience operating in a commercial function (not necessarily CRM), with the ability to bridge lifecycle marketing thinking with commercial opportunities.- A successful experience (3+ years) in CRM, lifecycle marketing, product marketing or a similar role, ideally in a subscription, e-commerce or FMCG environment- An analytical mindset — comfortable using data to inform decisions and optimize campaigns- Ability to manage multiple priorities independently, across global and local stakeholders- Fluent in English; notions of German, French, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian or Danish is a plus- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business or a related fieldWhat we offerCompensation & Financial Wellbeing- You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.- Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.- Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.Health & Wellbeing- Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.- Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.Flexibility & Work-Life- Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.- Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.- Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.Career & Development- Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.Culture & Environment- Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.- We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.Are you up for the challenge?Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Marketing-Management, Customer-Relationship-Management (CRM), Projektmanagement

FACILITIES MANAGER (F/M/D)At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our software platforms support clinical trials, diagnostics, and medical decision?making in highly controlled regulatory environments.As Facilities Manager (f/m/d), you will primarily focus on Clario’s Estenfeld facility (~90%), while also overseeing and providing organizational support for Munich and Karlsruhe offices (~10%).WHAT WE OFFER* Competitive compensation.* Flexible working hours and working time accounts to support the work-life balance.* Work primarily on-site, typically 4-5 days per week, with some flexibility for occasional remote work.* Support your professional development through internal and external training and certification programs.* Attractive benefits (security, flexibility, support and well-being).* Engaging employee programs.WHAT YOU´LL BE DOING* Facilities Operations: Providing overall facilities support by ensuring the seamless delivery of facility operations, building management, structural measures, maintenance teams, housekeeping, reception, cafeteria operations, asset management, visitor management, and security & safety protocols.* Facility Layout Standards and Compliance: Supporting facility layout standards for electrical systems, HVAC, IT infrastructure (phones, conference systems, displays), materials, access control and more. Collaborating with local contractors/vendors/departments to manage these processes through to completion, ensuring compliance with local and state building codes.* Site Coordination: Managing and coordinating the logistics involved in opening, relocating, or closing a facility, including security systems, access control, furniture, signage, showroom/marketing requirements, telecommunications, and more.* Budgeting and Capital Expenditure: Actively participating in the capital expenditure budgeting process and managing purchasing requests for facility needs. Accurately forecasting and preparing facility-related budgets. Conducting financial and business analysis, including preparing reports on expenditures, savings, and areas for cost optimization.* Compliance and Standards Development: Ensuring all facilities are operated and maintained in compliance with local, state, and national laws, company standards, and procedures. Responsible for developing and refining standards as business needs evolve, including ensuring annual occupational safety and fire inspections where applicable.* Stakeholder and Management Communication: Maintaining a dotted line to the local management teams, participating in and reporting at management meetings. Building strong relationships with key business stakeholders by collecting feedback and delivering reports on business-critical aspects, such as occupancy, site launches, and facility improvements and audits.* External Relations and First Point of Contact: Serving as the First Point of Contact for the landlord, labor inspectorate, municipalities, authorities, and occupational safety departments.* Vendor and Contractor Management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with local building management and managing third-party contractors/vendors responsible for facility maintenance and operations. This includes monitoring tasks completed, overseeing technical acceptance, and approving invoices.* Lease and Contract Management: Managing leases and facility agreements, including understanding legal terms and commercial contract structures.
